reason: B provides the cleaner, more decisive test: a multilayer coating versus a monolithic coating of the same overall composition, directly isolating interface density, coherency, and misfit fields as barriers to dislocation-mediated creep. A is substantially confounded by simultaneous alloying and processing changes, and its cited evidence mainly concerns hardness or serrated grain boundaries in a bulk alloy rather than time-dependent deformation in HEA multilayers.
